answer_2.quote: We explore CLIPScore ... and a DINOv2 (DinoScore) to automatically evaluate the generated images. ... automated metrics exhibit minimal differentiation ...

answer_3.quote: We also explored using the multimodal LLM llava-v1.6-vicuna-13b-hf ... Its limited accuracy (≈70 % overall, 62 % on semantic queries) suggests current multimodal LLMs still struggle with interpreting fine-grained action semantics.

answer_4.quote: A total of 25 annotators, hired via Amazon Mechanical Turk where each image was independently rated by 3 annotators. Each annotator was instructed to answer "Yes" or "No" to the question: "Does the image accurately depict the action described in the prompt?"
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answer Yes/No to the question: "Does the image accurately depict the action described in the prompt?"
